steps.text:
All 3 tests pass. 

I fixed `parse_duration` in `duration.py` to handle combined unit strings like `"1h30m"`. The new implementation uses `re.findall` to extract all `(number, unit)` pairs and sums their contributions in seconds, while still validating that the entire input string is consumed (so malformed inputs still raise `ValueError`).
